name: HP/MP recovery: natural regeneration, chairs, Recovery skill, consumables, level-up

statements: When you're not in combat, just standing still will slowly restore your HP.
Just press the sit key when you're near one, and you'll notice that your recovery speed is faster than when you're just standing.
natural_regeneration.statement_source_note: Quest 1016 (Rain's Maple Quiz 4) NPC dialogue: qualitative only.

chairs.name: The Green Relaxer
chairs.item_page_statement: Catch your breath and relax by sitting on this chair to restore an additional 30 HP every 10 seconds.

chairs.name: Sky-blue Wooden Chair
chairs.item_page_statement: A specially-made sky-blue wooden chair that's only available in Lith Harbor. Restores an additional 30 HP every 10 seconds.

chairs_note: Item detail pages (priority 1) say the chair restores an ADDITIONAL 30 HP every 10 seconds ("HP Recovery +30"; MeowDB item API stat "hpRecoverBonus": 30): a bonus on top of the character's own resting regeneration, whose amount is undocumented. The Beginner's guide table shortens this to "30 HP every 10 s" (see discrepancies).
chairs_statements: The Green Relaxer Pio's quest, Maple Island Free 30 HP every 10 s
Sky-blue Wooden Chair Mina, Lith Harbor 1,000 mesos 30 HP every 10 s
recovery_skill: See beginner.json skills (Recovery, skill 0001001: fixed HP total over 30 s).

consumables.rule: Potions and food restore the flat amount listed on each item page (items domain is authoritative).
statements: Potions are most of what you spend mesos on early. Mobs drop them rarely, so buy the ones that restore the most per meso:
Switch to basic attacks when MP is low; they cost no MP.
consumables.orange_potion_id_note: The guide does not link Orange Potion; id 271 is taken from its item page (/item-db/271).

level_up_heal.statement: Unlike leveling up, job advancing does not heal you.
level_up_heal.note: Implied only: MeowDB contrasts job advancement (no heal) with leveling up. The amount (full or partial) is not stated.

gaps: Natural HP and MP regeneration amounts and intervals (standing, sitting on the ground, and the base resting regen that a chair's "additional" 30 HP / 10 s is added to) are not documented; only "slowly restore" (standing) and "faster" (chairs) are stated.
Whether natural regeneration also restores MP is not stated.
What counts as "in combat" (timer after hitting / being hit) is not documented.
Potion use cooldown / animation lock is not documented.
Level-up heal amount is not documented.

discrepancies.topic: Chair HP recovery: total or bonus

values.text: Table "Chair / Where / Cost / Restores": The Green Relaxer Pio's quest, Maple Island Free 30 HP every 10 s / Sky-blue Wooden Chair Mina, Lith Harbor 1,000 mesos 30 HP every 10 s
Catch your breath and relax by sitting on this chair to restore an additional 30 HP every 10 seconds. (HP Recovery +30)
Restores an additional 30 HP every 10 seconds. (HP Recovery +30, Required Level 5)

discrepancies.chosen: additional_hp_per_tick 30 every 10 s, added on top of the (undocumented) natural resting regeneration
discrepancies.reason: Item detail pages are priority 1 and both say "additional"; MeowDB's item API names the stat hpRecoverBonus. The guide table is a shortened summary.
